newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel reorganizes operating groups.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel reorganizes operating groups.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said Monday it was reorganizing its operating facilities into separate wheel and tire groups, effective immediately.
The wheel group will be known as Titan Wheel Corp and the tire group will be known as Titan Tire Corp, the company said.
The groups will have individual presidents, and Maurice Taylor will continue to serve as president and chief executive of Titan Wheel International.
The wheel group will handle all wheel manufacturing and mounted assembly sales. Mike Samide has been promoted to president of Titan Wheel Corp, which will be headquartered in Quincy, Illinois.

The tire group will handle all tire manufacturing and sales and will be headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa. A search is being conducted for a president of Titan Tire Corp. Until a candidate is found, Taylor will be acting president of the group.
To reflect the new structure, a corporate name change to Titan International will be put to a vote at the annual shareholders' meeting in May, the company said.
